title: Understanding Exponential Regularization
text: Think about how the exponential function behaves compared to linear functions. How does the value of $${10}^{\theta_i}$$ change as $$\theta_i$$ increases or decreases?

title: Comparing with L2 Regularization
text: Consider how L2 regularization penalizes coefficients. It uses the square of the coefficients. How does squaring a number compare to raising $$10$$ to the power of that number?

title: Feature Selection with L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization is known for its ability to perform feature selection. It can set some coefficients to zero. Why might exponential regularization not have this property?
